projection.name: memcached
projection.title: Memcached
projection.description: Memcached workspace with an LRU key browser, live cache metrics, a slab allocation map, segmented-LRU and connection statistics, a watcher activity feed, and an audited command console.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.help: Token authentication requires memcached started with an -Y authfile.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable credential; its stored username is used as the memcached auth token username.

fields.label: TLS mode
fields.help: Requires memcached built and started with --enable-ssl.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for mTLS.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks stores, deletes, flushes, and every runtime tuning command.

fields.label: Key scan cap
fields.help: Maximum items the LRU crawler dump walks before the key browser stops and reports a truncated scan.

fields.label: Value preview limit
fields.help: Bytes of a value returned to the browser before it is truncated.

fields.label: Watcher feeds
fields.help: Feeds subscribed on the dedicated watcher connection that backs the Activity timeline.

fields.label: Activity buffer
fields.help: Number of watcher events kept in memory for the Activity timeline.

config.instructions: Each row is one slab class. The bar shows allocated capacity, the filled part shows used chunks, and the amber part is memory lost to chunk rounding. Use Up and Down to select a class.

config.emptyText: No slab class holds items yet.
No watcher events yet. memcached only reports events that happen while this tab's watcher is attached.

config.label: memcached command
config.emptyText: Run a memcached command, for example "stats slabs" or "mg mykey v t f".

validators.message: up to 250 bytes, no spaces or control characters

options.label: Add (only if the key is absent)

fields.label: TTL (seconds)
fields.help: 0 never expires. Values above 2592000 (30 days) are read by memcached as an absolute Unix timestamp.

fields.label: Client flags
fields.help: Opaque 32-bit value clients use to tag the serialization format.

fields.label: CAS id
fields.help: The CAS id read from the item; the store fails if the item changed since.

fields.label: Increment by
fields.help: The stored value must be an unsigned decimal number.

fields.label: Decrement by
fields.help: The stored value must be an unsigned decimal number.

fields.label: Slab classes
fields.help: "all", or a comma separated list of slab class ids to reclaim expired items from.

actions.label: Reset statistics
actions.confirmText: Reset every counter on this memcached server? Hit ratios, eviction counts, and traffic totals restart from zero for all clients.

actions.label: Set memory limit
actions.confirmText: Change the cache memory limit at runtime? Lowering it can force memcached to evict live items.

actions.label: Set verbosity
actions.confirmText: Change server log verbosity? High verbosity can flood the memcached host's logs.

actions.label: Flush cache
actions.confirmText: Invalidate every item on this memcached server? All clients lose their cached data immediately and will fall through to the origin.

fields.label: Delay (seconds)
fields.help: 0 invalidates immediately. A delay lets a pool of servers be flushed in staggered waves.

fields.label: Command
fields.help: Validated against the console allow-list before it is saved.
